Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below and I attached the partially completed vendor security questionnaire (Lakeshore_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx).

- SOC 2: We do not have a SOC 2 Type II yet; Type I completed in Q2 2025. We engaged an auditor and expect Type II by end of Jan 2027 (audit window is Dec 2026 - Jan 2027).
- HIPAA / BAA: We operate on PHI in certain products and can sign a BAA. Legal prefers to use a mutual BAA; happy to coordinate a redline when you send a draft.
- SSO / SAML: We use Okta with SAML 2.0. We can provide IdP metadata and prefer SP-initiated flows for end users.
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 provisioning is on the roadmap (Q1 2027). Today we have a manual provisioning flow and LDAP sync for some systems.
- RBAC: Built-in roles: Owner, Admin, Developer, Viewer. We can create custom roles; permission model is resource-based with explicit allow lists.
- Admin controls & audit logs: Audit logs retained 12 months. We can provide a CSV export and a sample admin console screenshot.

I'll upload the questionnaire and the IdP metadata to the shared folder you provided. For the technical handoff, Nov 18 or Nov 19 morning PST works for our Okta engineer.
